title: Improve conditional exponent saving to 0.000662684929829677
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The selected PR186 frames certify an exponent saving of `0.000661885549259598`. A further 1,953 operation-frame contractions yield the conditional candidate

```
kappa = 662684929829677 / 10^18 = 0.000662684929829677
T(n) = O(n (log n)^0.999337315070170323).
```

This increases the exponent saving by approximately **0.1207732320%**. It is not a measured runtime improvement. The complete paid profile retains `m=66`, `W=13326`, total rank `878196`, deficit `1320`, and all 46 terminal sinks.

Add a separate, pinned research package with explicit frame witnesses, regenerated compiler receipts, an exact rational certificate, and a proof argument. Its verifier replays the immutable predecessor, scalar and formal-column checks, the complex moment, and all 47 downstream assembly constraints. Independent base-two rational tests accept the new saving, reject the next grid point, and show that the original histogram cannot certify the new saving. Include the package in the Makefile and CI verification matrix.

The scalar DAG, compensated matching, bank schedule, bit supplier, and all-size analytic/compiler/routing/restoration/precision/fixed-tape assumptions remain inherited. Finite verification does not formally prove the all-size multiplication theorem. This candidate has not received independent human review; the selected-result pointer remains unchanged. The successor-grid exclusion concerns this fixed witness and does not establish global optimality.

Predecessor attribution and license notices are retained in `PROOF.md`, `NOTICE`, and the pinned dependencies. This contribution was prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Validation

- Passed `make entrance-bank-verify` for the immutable selected predecessor and bank schedule.
- Passed the complete candidate replay and exact certificate comparison on Python 3.13 and 3.14, including scalar execution, both shear signs, terminal formal columns, dirty restoration, rational moment bounds, and all 47 strict assembly constraints.
- Passed the independent rational moment tests on Python 3.13 and 3.14.
- Applied the patch to a clean checkout of baseline `3b6b66891c0ac888521cf591fe306c6286601d4f`; all candidate inventory hashes matched. Passed `git diff --check`.
- The repository-wide `make verify` run completed the community, producers, partial-gauge, three-stage-cover, paired-cube, recycled-bit (all 202190 inclusions), entrance-banks, frame-closure, certificates, and ternary groups. It was intentionally interrupted during the historical quadratic-affine audit in `verify-research` (exit 130). **The full historical suite has not completed; no all-tests-passed claim is made.** All checks for the changed construction and the new tests passed separately.
